notes: Five new games: Tile Runs (build runs and groups, jokers are wild), Lumen Run (collect the lights, dodge the hunters), Crazy Eights, Durak and War. Plus a round of fixes from testing: chess pieces are readable again, Sudoku no longer gets stuck after you finish a level, every game offers a rematch, basketball works with a mouse, dice roll in 3D, and the buttons in chat games are no longer cut off. Posting a photo status now works reliably.
